idea: An online booking and membership app for our network of 12 yoga studios: members book classes, buy passes and get reminders.
interviewAnswers: €15,000 to build and at most €400 a month to run.
Two JavaScript developers, three days a week each, comfortable with React and Node.js.
Member data must stay in the EU. We must launch before September.
debateAnswers: Yes, a hosted platform is fine if it fits the monthly cap with EU hosting.
